recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: The service used a pool size of 10 after a configuration change, below the normal production value of 40.
successful_steps: Confirmed pool wait time returned to baseline
resolution: A configuration change reduced the database connection pool from 40 to 10. Restoring the expected pool size resolved the failures.
postmortem: Adding replicas did not solve the per-process pool limit.
Cache clearing had no effect on DB connection waits.
